Note::ends_with¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

std::vector<std::uint8_t> Note::ends_with(std::string_view suffix) const

Test Every Cell For A Literal Suffix¶

ends_with(suffix) reports, for each text cell, whether it ends with the literal string suffix. It is the anchored-at-the-end companion of starts_with and contains: use it for extension checks, terminal-punctuation checks, or unit suffixes.

The test is a literal byte comparison — no regex, no case folding. For a case-insensitive extension check (.md vs .MD), fold case first with lower.

Return value¶

Not a Note: a flat std::vector<std::uint8_t>, one entry per cell (1 / 0), row-major, length numel().

Edge cases¶

  • An empty suffix is a suffix of every cell → all 1.

  • A suffix longer than a cell → 0.

Example 1: An Extension Check¶

const auto mask =
    pluss::make_note({"report.md", "notes.MD", "data.csv"}).ends_with(".md");
std::cout << "[";
for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mask.size(); ++i)
  std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << static_cast<int>(mask[i]);
std::cout << "]\n";

Output¶

[1, 0, 0]

"notes.MD" differs in case; use .lower().ends_with(".md") to accept it.

Example 2: An Empty Suffix Matches Everything¶

const auto mask = pluss::make_note({"x", ""}).ends_with("");
std::cout << "[";
for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mask.size(); ++i)
  std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << static_cast<int>(mask[i]);
std::cout << "]\n";

Output¶

[1, 1]

Example 3: A Suffix Longer Than The Cell¶

const auto mask = pluss::make_note({"ab"}).ends_with("abcd");
std::cout << "[" << static_cast<int>(mask[0]) << "]\n";

Output¶

[0]

Example 4: Higher-Rank Input Is Flattened Row-Major¶

const auto mask =
    pluss::make_note({{"a.py", "b.py"}, {"c.js", "d.py"}}).ends_with(".py");
std::cout << "[";
for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mask.size(); ++i)
  std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << static_cast<int>(mask[i]);
std::cout << "]\n";

Output¶

[1, 1, 0, 1]

See Also¶

  • Note::starts_with: the anchored-at-the-start counterpart.

  • Note::contains: match anywhere in the cell.

  • pluss::coden::Note::remove_suffix / ensure_suffix: act on the suffix rather than test for it.
